body: SCOUT REVIEW HOLD on cost-support candidate 19510e9, bead bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF. The estimator change is coherent, but the wire claim is not yet truthful. codec HsmmResultCodec still declares SchemaVersion = hsmm/v1 while CostBreakdownWire adds required supportWeight and the committed v1 golden is recut. ADR 0001 explicitly defines hsmm/v1 cost as exactly terms/mode/exclusion/total/missingTerms/sourceChartCoverage/reductions, and codec README calls that golden canonical. Consequences: an old valid hsmm/v1 artifact now fails decode for missing supportWeight, while the new materially different artifact carries the same version tag. Defaulting old supportWeight to 1.0 would be scientifically false: the old bare-sum cost did not establish full eligible support. Chief/ADR decision required before merge: likely bump to hsmm/v2 and update ADR/README/version law/golden, or define an explicit honest v1 migration. No edit; exact-SHA source review only.
